issues.evidence: raw_median 19.135 (raw_median_z -5.659), while the other 11 channels lie between 19.908 and 20.332 (|z| <= 1.574). n_quantified is 1397, versus 1458-1472 in the other channels. Its paired IgG channel R2_CPI_IgG has raw_median 20.009 (z -0.377), so the deficit is specific to this channel. Other metrics are ordinary: antibody_corr 0.968 (z 0.682), pc1_z_within_antibody 0.518, and for culture CPI169_2 slope_vs_other_cultures 0.953 and ratio_iqr 0.559, in line with the other cultures (slopes 0.929-0.953, IQR 0.546-0.620).
issues.impact: This channel is the EZH2 member of the CPI169_2 pair. It affects EZH2_vs_IgG_in_CPI169 (within-culture) and the interaction (within-culture), because the CPI169_2 EZH2-minus-IgG ratio rests on it. It also affects CPI169_vs_DMSO_in_EZH2 (between-culture). The IgG-based contrasts, CPI169_vs_DMSO_in_IgG and the DMSO within-culture contrasts, are not affected. The effect is limited to one of three CPI-169 cultures. Other metrics show no ratio compression or loss of antibody structure. The direction of any bias is not clear from the metrics. CPI169_2 has the most negative median_ratio (-0.26, versus -0.149 and -0.204 in the other CPI-169 cultures), but this is within the spread of all six cultures (-0.115 to -0.26). If the lower loading does depress EZH2-versus-IgG ratios in this culture, the CPI-169 ratio would be pulled down and the interaction (CPI-169 minus DMSO) biased slightly negative. The metrics cannot confirm this.
issues.recommendation: Check whether the low median reflects a real loading deficit, using the raw intensity distribution and the missingness of low-abundance proteins in this channel. Run a sensitivity analysis that excludes the CPI169_2 pair, or down-weights it, and see whether the interaction and EZH2_vs_IgG_in_CPI169 results change. Interpret proteins with missing values in this channel cautiously.

summary: Quality is generally good. PC1 separates antibody (association 0.999) and PC2 separates compound (0.968), as designed. Within-antibody correlations are uniform (0.963-0.969), and paired-ratio slopes (0.929-0.953) and IQRs are consistent across the six cultures. The one clear departure is R2_CPI_EZH2, which has low loading (raw_median_z -5.659) and fewer quantified proteins (1397). Because its other metrics are normal, this is a modest concern. The contrasts to treat with caution are the interaction, EZH2_vs_IgG_in_CPI169 and CPI169_vs_DMSO_in_EZH2, and a sensitivity analysis excluding culture CPI169_2 is advised.
